model.name: 问题四（波动电价）问题二：因果光伏预测 + CVaR日前购电 + 因果滚动储能执行
model.price_source: 附件4，每天144个十分钟价格
model.forecast_source: 价格采用截至目标日前的因果Fourier-岭回归（年周期+周周期）；光伏沿用问题二因果多日预测
model.strategy: 每天0:00制定当前日计划购电量；实际光伏逐时揭示并执行因果滚动储能控制
model.spill_definition: 问题二复用的curtailment变量表示总供给溢出（光伏与已计划购电的未利用量）；问题三另行报告unused_grid
model.stress_scenario: 配对历史PV-价格场景并加入低光伏/高价格压力场景；价格风险通过场景紧急费用与CVaR进入LP
model.price_risk_method: causal point forecast + paired PV-price scenario CVaR
model.price_scenario_role: paired historical PV-price scenarios enter scenario emergency costs and CVaR; no additive first-stage price premium
model.price_risk_conditioning: first-stage price premium is disabled in the formal model; same-origin PV-price residual pairs are retained in the joint scenario CVaR
model.price_settlement: 计划层使用因果点预测价（正式模型不叠加首阶段价格溢价）；最终计划和紧急费用按附件4实际价结算

execution_price_information.usage: each MPC solve replaces only its first coefficient with the current observed price

price_pv_correlation.independence_rule: 仅在去月份/星期/时段结构后的Pearson与Spearman绝对值均小于0.10时采用独立场景
